description: This is a test class for the AnySoftKeyboardKeyboardTagsSearcher component, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of quick text tags search functionality, suggestion handling, preference changes, and UI interactions within the keyboard app.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardKeyboardTagsSearcherTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of the keyboard's quick text tags search feature, including suggestion generation, preference handling, and UI interactions.

methods.name: setUpTagsLoad
methods.description: Initializes background and foreground schedulers before each test.

methods.name: testDefaultFalseBeforeAPI22
methods.description: Verifies that the quick text tags searcher is disabled on API levels below 22.

methods.name: testDefaultTrueAtAPI22
methods.description: Verifies that the quick text tags searcher is enabled on API level 22 and above.

methods.name: testOnSharedPreferenceChangedCauseLoading
methods.description: Checks that changing the relevant shared preference loads or unloads the searcher accordingly.

methods.name: testUnrelatedOnSharedPreferenceChangedDoesNotCreateSearcher
methods.description: Ensures that unrelated preference changes do not recreate the searcher.

methods.name: testEnabledTypingTagProvidesSuggestionsFromTagsOnly
methods.description: Tests that typing a colon triggers suggestions from tags only, and that suggestions update correctly after deletions.

methods.name: testDeleteLetters
methods.description: Verifies suggestion updates when deleting characters after typing tags.

methods.name: testOnlyTagsAreSuggestedWhenTypingColon
methods.description: Ensures only tag suggestions are shown when typing after a colon.

methods.name: testTagsSearchDoesNotAutoPick
methods.description: Checks that typing a tag does not automatically select it.

methods.name: testTagsSearchThrice
methods.description: Verifies repeated typing of the same tag does not alter suggestion list.

methods.name: testPickingEmojiOutputsToInput
methods.description: Tests that selecting an emoji suggestion inserts it into the input and handles deletion correctly.

methods.name: testPickingEmojiStoresInHistory
methods.description: Verifies that picked emojis are stored in the quick key history.

methods.name: testPickingEmojiDoesNotTryToGetNextWords
methods.description: Ensures that picking an emoji does not trigger next-word suggestions.

methods.name: testPickingTypedTagDoesNotTryToAddToAutoDictionary
methods.description: Checks that manually picked tags are not added to the auto dictionary.

methods.name: testPickingSearchCellInSuggestionsOutputTypedWord
methods.description: Verifies that selecting a suggestion with a search icon outputs the typed word.

methods.name: testDisabledTypingTagDoesNotProvidesSuggestions
methods.description: Ensures no suggestions are provided when the feature is disabled via preferences.

methods.name: testQuickTextEnabledPluginsPrefsChangedCauseReload
methods.description: Checks that plugin preference changes cause the searcher to reload.

methods.name: testQuickTextEnabledPluginsPrefsChangedDoesNotCauseReloadIfTagsSearchIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that plugin preference changes do not reload the searcher if the feature is disabled.

methods.name: testEnsureSuggestionsAreIterable
methods.description: Ensures the suggestions list is iterable and contains only CharSequence objects.

methods.name: testRemoveIteratorUnSupported
methods.description: Verifies that removing elements via iterator throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: testAddingAtIndexToSuggestionsUnSupported
methods.description: Verifies that adding suggestions at a specific index throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: testAddingToSuggestionsUnSupported
methods.description: Verifies that adding suggestions directly throws UnsupportedOperationException.

methods.name: testListIteratorUnSupported
methods.description: Verifies that list iterator is unsupported and throws exception.

methods.name: testRemoteAtIndexUnSupported
methods.description: Verifies that removing suggestions by index throws exception.

methods.name: testRemoteObjectUnSupported
methods.description: Verifies that removing suggestions by object throws exception.
